associations.rationale: The type directly states that the characters of the four indexed representations on the four class representatives equal the displayed table entries.
The type directly gives the four conjugacy-class sizes as 1, 4, 4, and 3, matching the displayed four-class data.
The type directly states that every simple complex representation of A4 is isomorphic to one of the four indexed representations, establishing completeness.

The type proves the four indexed representations are pairwise nonisomorphic; this supports the four-row classification but does not itself state the displayed classes, characters, quotient, or deleted representation.
The type states that an opaque map qHom is surjective with kernel V4, but its displayed type does not identify the codomain as Z/3 or state the quotient isomorphism.
The type directly states that each of the four indexed representations is simple, matching the assertion that the four displayed rows are irreducible.
